_comment: Cross-area research threads. POSITION BASE for future papers: attach each new paper to exactly one thread first, then choose 1-3 parents from that thread’s members (ordered oldest to newest). Adding a paper = append member + edges; do not reorder members.
_placement_protocol: Match the paper to a thread by its position_guide trigger; if none fits, create a new thread rather than forcing it.
Pick 1-3 parents from the thread members that the paper directly extends, evaluates, or repairs; record relation builds_on with a one-sentence rationale.
Write the area page entries (Timeline chronological, Paper List batch, Recent Activity line) and the lineage edges in the paper’s primary area file; add cross_area bridges for parents in other areas.
Add the paper as a node in _meta/graphify_seed/graph.json with the thread’s community number and a hyperedge update.

threads.label: Time Series + LLM Reasoning
threads.description: The arc from zero-shot TS forecasting with frozen LLMs, through the diagnosis that forecasting does not imply reasoning, to aligned TS-LLM models, RL-incentivized reasoning, verifiable thinking data, and clinical benchmarks.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it trains or evaluates an LLM that reads time series, synthesizes TS reasoning traces, or benchmarks TS reasoning. Parents: the closest method it modifies (ChatTS/TS-Reasoner for alignment, TimeOmni-1/VeriTime for RL and data, Merrill/SenTSR/TSRBench for evals).

threads.label: Latent / Continuous Reasoning
threads.description: Reasoning moved off language tokens: superposition theory for continuous chain-of-thought, then latent visual reasoning in Monet. Related Zotero items already in reasoning.md: Coconut, CODI, Chain of Superposition (Deng), Latent Space Survey.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it reasons in a continuous latent space instead of discrete tokens. Parents: the CoT baseline it replaces and the nearest latent-reasoning method.

threads.label: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
threads.description: Do CoT traces reflect actual reasoning? Unfaithful explanations, faithfulness measurement, per-step necessity and accuracy probes, and hallucination snowballing through generation.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it analyzes, measures, or repairs the fidelity of reasoning traces. Parents: CoT plus the specific faithfulness claim it tests.

threads.label: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
threads.description: Chain-of-thought generalized to interleaved modalities: interleaved-modal CoT, grounded CoT, internalized visual thinking; plus the visual-token efficiency line (1/2 tokens after layer 2, one-token LLaVA-Mini).
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it reasons across image and text or compresses visual tokens for reasoning. Parents: the CoT variant it extends and the VLM efficiency method it builds on.

threads.label: Time Series Foundation Models
threads.description: Decoder-only forecasting foundation models and wearable-sensing foundation models; TS-Reasoner aligns them with LLM reasoning.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it pretraining a general time-series or wearable-sensing backbone. Parents: the backbone architecture and the FM it scales or specializes.

threads.label: Vision SSL and Regularization Classics
threads.description: Regularization lineage (Dropout to Cutout) and masked-autoencoder theory as the self-supervised vision anchor; MIRAGE evaluates whether VLMs truly understand images.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it is a regularization method, a masked self-supervised vision method, or a probe of visual understanding.

threads.label: LLM Efficiency and Analysis Foundations
threads.description: Transformer analysis beyond attention (residual and normalization layers) and the attention-sink fix for streaming inference.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it analyzes transformer internals or fixes an inference-time failure mode. Parents: the transformer component it studies.

threads.label: Agent Memory Systems
threads.description: How LLM agents remember across episodes: hierarchical memory indexes, topic documents, semantic consolidation, memory RL, spatial and procedural memory, plus benchmarks and a survey of memory mechanisms.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it stores, indexes, compresses, or manages an agent’s memory across episodes or long horizons. Parents: the memory system it extends or the benchmark it is measured against.

threads.label: Agentic RL and Self-Evolution
threads.description: Training agents with reinforcement learning and letting them improve themselves: orchestration traces, programmatic rewards, skill evolution, on-policy distillation for agents, synthetic training tasks, and early evidence on open-ended AI research by agents.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it trains agents with RL, distills or evolves agent skills, or synthesizes agentic training data. Parents: the RL method or distillation baseline it modifies.

threads.label: Agent Planning and Search
threads.description: From theory of mind through decomposition-and-planning (ADaPT) and tree search over language actions (LATS) to planning benchmarks and deep-research agents.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if the agent plans, searches, or decomposes tasks before acting. Parents: the planning or search method it extends.

threads.label: Multimodal and Embodied Agents
threads.description: Agents that see and act: agentic vision with dynamic tooling, multimodal models for embodied interaction, evidence-first interactive diagnosis, and frontier deep-research agents.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if the agent perceives images or video, or acts in an embodied or interactive environment. Parents: the vision-language or agent backbone it builds on.

threads.label: Wearable and Biosignal Foundation Models
threads.description: Self-supervised pretraining on wearable and physiological signals at scale: HAR at 700K person-days, bidirectional Mamba encoders, health acoustic representations, cross-modal PPG-ECG models, sleep and neuroimaging foundation models, and ECG benchmarks.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it pretrains a general model on wearable, biosignal, or physiological data. Parents: the backbone architecture and the closest prior biosignal FM.

threads.label: Medical Reasoning and Evaluation
threads.description: Do medical LLMs reason well enough to trust? Few-shot health learning, sensor-to-text interaction, agentic healthcare models, RL for medical multimodal reasoning, radiology drafting, and a wave of 2026 benchmarks for wearable QA, mental-health sensing, and auditable diagnosis.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it trains or evaluates clinical reasoning, medical QA, or health benchmarks. Parents: the clinical task definition it follows and the model family it evaluates.

threads.label: Diffusion and Generative Vision
threads.description: From GAN image translation through text-conditional diffusion and transformer diffusion backbones to controllable video generation, reward-tilted few-step generators, and MLLMs as zero-shot reward models for generation.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it generates images, video, or 3D content with diffusion, flow, or GAN models. Parents: the generative backbone it modifies and the control or reward method it adds.

threads.label: Video World Models
threads.description: World models as game engines and physical predictors: multi-agent video world models, action-conditioned models for robotics, long-horizon interactive modeling, plus probes of where world-action models dream right but act wrong.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it builds, scales, or probes a video or world model for physical or embodied prediction. Parents: the world-model architecture it scales and the evaluation it targets.

threads.label: State-Space and Hybrid Architectures
threads.description: Beyond pure attention: bidirectional SSMs for HAR, audio, and medical imaging; hybrid attention-recurrent models; quantization and activation analysis of the recurrent half; sleep-style consolidation of context into fast weights.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it designs, hybridizes, or analyzes state-space, linear-recurrent, or hybrid attention architectures. Parents: the SSM or attention baseline it modifies.

threads.label: Self-Supervised Learning for Sensors
threads.description: Masked and contrastive pretraining move from pixels to sensors: masked autoencoding theory, HAR at population scale, audio and sensor-text alignment, sleep physiology, neuroimaging, and EEG-language representation learning.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it pretrains representations on sensor, audio, or physiological data without labels. Parents: the SSL objective it adapts and the sensor domain it targets.

threads.label: Test-Time Training and Adaptation
threads.description: Learning does not stop at deployment: parameter-efficient test-time adaptation for forecasting, evidence-aligned selective training for long-context QA, test-time policy optimization, and context scaling for robot policies.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it updates weights, memory, or policy at test or inference time. Parents: the base model or adaptation method it extends.

threads.label: RL for LLM Reasoning
threads.description: The RL substrate under reasoning models: sample-efficient planning, off-policy evaluation, cross-domain perspectives on RL for reasoning, and distilling exploration before reinforcing refinement.
threads.position_guide: Attach a paper here if it studies RL methods for LLM reasoning: exploration, evaluation, or cross-domain transfer. Parents: the RL algorithm or reasoning setup it builds on.
